issues.description: The problem statement text (task description) specifies addGuestStudents(String) while the UML and the reference solution use addGuestStudents(int). This contradiction can confuse students about the expected parameter type for addGuestStudents and may lead to incorrect implementations.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the parameter type across the problem statement, template, and solution. Update the task description in problem_statement.md to specify addGuestStudents(int) to match the UML and the solution implementation (or alternatively change the UML and solution to use String if that was intended). Ensure the template's TODO includes the correct signature to avoid student confusion.

issues.description: The problem statement text specifies addGuestStudents(String) as the required method signature, while the UML diagram and the provided solution implementation use addGuestStudents(int). This mismatch in the parameter type for the same method name can confuse students about whether to accept a String or an int and which signature to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type consistent across artifacts. Update problem_statement.md to specify addGuestStudents(int) to match the UML and the solution (and the intended numeric addition behavior), or if a String was intended, update the UML, template TODOs, and the solution to use addGuestStudents(String) and document the expected parsing behavior.
